fk.label: FK, joined
fk.description: Joined in the workload, and a declared foreign key covers the join.

no_fk.label: Joined, no FK
no_fk.description: Joined in the workload on columns no foreign key covers — a missing constraint, or a join that may need an index on the join column.

fk_unused.label: FK, never joined
fk_unused.description: Foreign key declared, but no tracked query joins on it — a dead relationship, or an FK index that costs writes without serving reads.

colorModeDescriptions.health: Worst open finding on the table (from the nightly deep scan).
colorModeDescriptions.seq: Rows read by sequential scans in the window — tables read in full, often.
colorModeDescriptions.writes: Rows inserted, updated and deleted in the window.

coverage.needsGenericPlan_one: {{count}} parameterized query needs PostgreSQL 16+ to be planned
coverage.needsGenericPlan_other: {{count}} parameterized queries need PostgreSQL 16+ to be planned
coverage.explainFailed_one: {{count}} couldn't be planned (utility statements such as SET or COMMIT, mostly)
coverage.explainFailed_other: {{count}} couldn't be planned (utility statements such as SET or COMMIT, mostly)
coverage.trackedExplained: Tracked queries are the top 50 by total time in pg_stat_statements.
coverage.meterLabel: Share of tracked DB time the map covers

legend.nodesExplained: Size: table size. Colour: {{description}} Faded: only on the map through a foreign key.

search.manyMatches_one: {{count}} tables match "{{term}}" — type more of the name.
search.manyMatches_other: {{count}} tables match "{{term}}" — type more of the name.
search.label: Find a table on the map

screen.emptyNoQueries: No queries are tracked yet. The map is built from the top 50 queries in pg_stat_statements, which DbButler starts tracking within a few minutes of connecting.
screen.emptyNonePlanned: None of the tracked queries has been planned yet. Their plans are read every 5 minutes (the plan regression job on the Settings screen) — check back shortly.
screen.emptyNoUserTables: No user tables to show: the tracked queries only touch system catalogs, or tables outside this connection's schema filter.
screen.showingPast: Showing the {{range}} up to {{until}}: the queries tracked then, weighted by the time they took in that window. Join columns come from each query's current plan.
screen.lifetimeWeights: No tracked query ran in the last {{range}}, so weights use each query's total since pg_stat_statements was last reset.
screen.truncated_one: Showing the {{count}} tables carrying the most DB time; {{more}} more are left off.
screen.truncated_other: Showing the {{count}} tables carrying the most DB time; {{more}} more are left off.
screen.graphLabel: Workload map: {{tables}} tables and {{edges}} relationships. The Relationships view lists the same information as a table.
screen.graph3dLabel: 3D workload map: {{tables}} tables, higher means more DB time. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. The Relationships view lists the same information as a table.
screen.note3d: 3D: height is the table's share of DB time, each schema is its own cluster, and relationships are told apart by colour only. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

graph.noWebgl: This browser has no WebGL, which the 3D view needs. The 2D map and the Relationships table show the same data.

panel.label: Selection details
panel.notJoined: Not joined with any other table in the tracked queries.
panel.noTableQueries: No tracked query touches this table — it's on the map through a foreign key.
panel.hypertableNote: TimescaleDB hypertable: scans of the per-chunk indexes aren't included in these counts.
panel.noFindings: None from the last deep scan.
panel.fkIndexed: The FK columns on {{child}} are indexed.
panel.fkNotIndexed: No index on {{child}} ({{columns}}). Joins from {{parent}}, and every DELETE or key update on {{parent}}, have to scan {{child}}. <link>See Index Advisor</link>.
panel.noFkTitle: Join conditions without a foreign key
panel.noLeadingIndex: no index leads with the join column
panel.noFkHint: If one side is meant to reference the other, declaring the foreign key documents it and lets PostgreSQL enforce it. A side without an index is scanned on every join.
panel.noEdgeQueries: No tracked query joins these tables.
panel.notOnMapHint: The selected item isn't part of this time range's map.

table.caption: Relationships between tables, from joins in the tracked queries and declared foreign keys
